title: Extend health checks with repository metrics
description:

Location: internal/commands/health/commands.go:184

Current health check only tests:
- Basic project listing
- Config retrieval

title: Implement auto-fix for dependency analysis
description:
The dependency analysis command has an auto-fix option that displays 'this feature is not yet implemented'.

Location: internal/commands/dependency/analysis.go:244

When users run with --auto-fix flag, they should get:
1. Automatic resolution of simple dependency issues
2. Suggestions for complex dependency problems
3. Interactive fixing options where needed
4. Preview of changes before applying

Common auto-fix scenarios:
- Remove broken dependencies
- Suggest task reordering
- Detect and warn about potential circular dependencies
- Recommend dependency simplifications

title: Implement template repository for persistence
description:
Templates are currently loaded but not persisted to database. Need to implement a template repository to store custom templates created by users.

Location: internal/commands/template/commands.go:392
TODO: 'Save to database when template repository is implemented'

The template load command validates templates but doesn't save them. Users should be able to:
1. Save custom templates to the database
2. List saved templates
3. Load templates from database
4. Delete saved templates

This requires implementing:
- Template repository interface and implementation
- Template database schema
- Template management commands (list, delete, etc.)
- Integration with existing template loading system

title: Fix gofmt in commands_update_test.go after removing unused function
Implement template dependency management
description:
When creating tasks from templates, dependencies between tasks are not yet created. Need to implement dependency management in template processing.

Location: internal/commands/template/helpers.go:292
TODO: 'Second pass for dependencies (requires dependency management implementation)'

Current template processing creates tasks but doesn't handle the dependency relationships between them. The system should:
1. Parse dependency definitions in templates
2. Create task dependencies after all tasks are created
3. Handle circular dependency validation
4. Support dependency types (blocks, depends_on, etc.)

This is critical for complex project templates where tasks have interdependencies.

title: Improve error mapping for SQLite repository
description:
Currently only handles constraint errors. Should add mappings for other Ent error types to provide more specific and helpful error messages.

Location: internal/repository/sqlite/repository.go:129
TODO: 'Add more specific error mapping for different ent error types'

The mapError function currently only handles:
- Constraint errors -> ConstraintViolationError
- Everything else -> generic ConnectionError

Should add handling for:
- NotFound errors -> NotFoundError
- Validation errors -> ValidationError
- Unique constraint errors (separate from general constraints)
- Foreign key constraint errors
- Transaction errors

This will improve debugging and provide better error messages to users.
